_comment: CR-30 (Fix-O, 2026-07-19): pyrefly baseline. Generated with `pyrefly check voice_typer/ --update-baseline`. Format matches pyrefly native output (top-level `errors` array). The audit step in .github/workflows/build.yml was updated to use the `errors` key (was `suppressed` — mismatched with pyrefly output, audit always saw 0).
_justification: See worklog Fix-O section for the full categorization. Summary: (1) Platform-specific / genuinely unfixable — 46 missing-attribute (Windows-only VoiceTyperApp attrs _mutex_handle/_kernel32/_devnull/_console_handler, macOS-only NSPasteboard/NSPasteboardItem, Windows-only msvcrt.locking/LK_LOCK, Windows-only kernel32 AddVectoredExceptionHandler/RemoveVectoredExceptionHandler, private ctypes._FuncPtr API, module-level dynamic attrs _scipy_preloader_thread/_resample_poly/_secure_clear_array/_config_dir_bytes, partial-migration register_tray_labels) + 1 missing-module-attribute (register_tray_labels). (2) Real type bugs to be fixed by other Fix agents — 9 bad-dunder-all (config_validators __all__ — Fix-A/F CR-29), 4 bad-argument-type, 3 unknown-name, 2 bad-assignment, 2 unbound-name, 1 bad-index, 1 bad-return, 1 not-callable, 1 unsupported-operation. (3) The CI workflow step `pyrefly check voice_typer/` exits 0 even with errors (pyrefly does not fail on type errors by default), so this baseline file is the only enforcement mechanism — the audit step (build.yml) catches growth.
_note_fluctuation: Error count fluctuates between 70-75 due to parallel Fix-agent file modifications (tray.py, recorder.py, config_validators.py, app.py, ipc_server.py, etc. were being actively edited). The value here reflects the latest stable sample. The audit step will catch growth above this baseline.
